scenarios.text_scenario: It is the last week of the month and you are wondering how much is left before your next salary.
examples: Mahine ke end mein kitna bacha hai?
Kitna paisa reh gaya account mein
Dekho na kitna balance bacha

scenarios.text_scenario: Someone promised to send you money and you want to see whether it has arrived.
examples: Paisa aaya kya mere account mein?
Credit hua ya nahi abhi tak
Koi amount aayi hai kya?

scenarios.text_scenario: You are about to book something online and want to be sure the payment will go through.
examples: Booking se pehle balance dekh lo
Itne paise hain ya nahi account mein?
Payment ho jayega, balance confirm karo

scenarios.text_scenario: You suspect you spent more than you planned this month and want to review where it went.
examples: Is mahine ka kharcha dikhao
Kahan kahan paise gaye batao
Transaction history nikaalo mera

scenarios.text_scenario: You need a short record of recent activity to show someone.
examples: Chhota sa statement chahiye
Pichhle kuch entries print karo
Account ki summary bhejo

scenarios.text_scenario: Your rent is due and you need to pay your landlord.
examples: Makan malik ko rent bhejna hai
Kiraya transfer karna hai aaj
Landlord ko payment kar do

scenarios.text_scenario: You owe a shopkeeper money and want to settle it digitally.
examples: Dukaandaar ko paise pahuncha do
Udhar chukana hai, transfer karo
Uska hisaab clear kar do online

scenarios.text_scenario: A relative asked for urgent help and you want to send money quickly.
examples: Turant paise bhejne hain chacha ko
Emergency hai, amount transfer karo
Abhi ke abhi paisa pahunchao

scenarios.text_scenario: Your bag was stolen on a bus and your cards were inside it.
examples: Bag chori ho gaya, saare cards rok do!
Chori ho gayi hai, card deactivate karo
Mera bag gaya, jaldi card rok do

scenarios.text_scenario: Your card got stuck inside an ATM machine and you are worried someone will retrieve it.
examples: Card machine mein fas gaya, band karo
ATM ne card kha liya, block karwao
Card nikla nahi, deactivate kar do

scenarios.text_scenario: You got a call from someone pretending to be from the bank and shared an OTP by mistake.
examples: OTP share kar diya galti se, madad karo
Fake call aayi thi, paise gaye
Dhokha ho gaya mere saath

scenarios.text_scenario: Small amounts have been disappearing from your account repeatedly over several days.
examples: Roz thode thode paise kat rahe hain
Baar baar amount nikal raha hai koi
Lagataar galat deduction ho raha hai

scenarios.text_scenario: Your old card expired last month and the replacement has not arrived.
examples: Purana card expire ho gaya, naya kahan hai?
Replacement card aaya nahi abhi tak
Renew wala card kab pahunchega?

scenarios.text_scenario: You were told the card was couriered but you have no tracking information.
examples: Courier hua tha, kahan pahuncha?
Delivery ka pata karo card ka
Kab tak haath mein aayega?

scenarios.text_scenario: You have not used your card in months and cannot recall the PIN at all.
examples: Bahut din se use nahi kiya, pin yaad nahi
Pin dobara set karwana hai
Naya password banwa do card ka

scenarios.text_scenario: You entered the wrong PIN too many times and the card got locked.
examples: Galat pin daal diya, card lock ho gaya
Zyada baar try kiya, ab unlock karo
Pin reset karna padega ab

scenarios.text_scenario: You are thinking of buying a two-wheeler and want to know your financing options.
examples: Bike ke liye finance mil sakta hai?
Gaadi lene ke liye kya option hai?
Two wheeler pe loan hota hai kya?

scenarios.text_scenario: Your child's college admission is coming up and you are exploring an education loan.
examples: Padhai ke liye loan kaise milega?
Education loan ke baare mein bataiye
College fees ke liye finance chahiye

scenarios.text_scenario: You already have a loan and want to know how many instalments are left.
examples: Kitni kisht baaki hai meri?
Loan kab tak khatam hoga?
Pending amount kitna reh gaya?

scenarios.text_scenario: The gas bill deadline is today and you do not want a late fee.
examples: Gas ka bill aaj bharna hai
Last date hai, payment kar do
Bill jama karo aaj hi

scenarios.text_scenario: Your broadband is about to be disconnected for non-payment.
examples: Internet ka bill pending hai, bhar do
Wifi katne wala hai, payment karo
Broadband ka paisa jama karwao

scenarios.text_scenario: You are travelling in a new city and need to withdraw cash.
examples: Naye sheher mein hoon, cash kahan milega?
Yahan paise nikalne ki jagah batao
Aas paas machine hai kya cash ke liye?

scenarios.text_scenario: You need to submit documents in person and want to know timings before travelling.
examples: Documents jama karne kahan jaunga?
Office kab khulta hai bank ka?
Kaunse din band rehta hai branch?

scenarios.text_scenario: You just started your first job and need an account for your salary.
examples: Naukri lagi hai, salary account chahiye
Pehli baar account bana raha hoon
Salary ke liye khata kholna hai

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to open an account for your child.
examples: Bachhe ke naam se khata khulwana hai
Minor ka account ban sakta hai?
Bete ke liye account chahiye

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker talks about something entirely personal and unrelated.
examples: Sar dard ho raha hai bahut
Kal shaadi mein jana hai
Neend nahi aa rahi raat bhar

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker asks something from another domain — education, travel, or assistant.
examples: Is chapter ka quiz le lo
Bus ka time batao
Volume thoda badha do

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker responds with filler or an unclear half-sentence.
examples: Arre wo kya tha
Ek minute ruko
Nahi nahi rehne do
